title: Qualify and execute authentic Abaqus 2023 simulation for Method A adapted off-axis hole model
scientific_objective: Execute the qualified indicator-driven adapted mesh (52,447 physical elements, 89.4% tip resolution, 90.6% ligament resolution <= 1.5 um) under Abaqus 2023 on mmaster02 to capture high-fidelity damage evolution and force-displacement response
